needs.what: a residual-gate claimant for an unkeyworded graveyard alternative cost that carries a non-mana payment: "You may cast ~ from your graveyard by paying <mana> and sacrificing <N> <noun> rather than paying its mana cost", matched against a card-level graveyard_cost of {mana, sacrifice: {types, controller: you, count: N}} with graveyard_cast "graveyard" (the card goes where it normally would)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The DSL already expresses the price -- graveyard_cost {"mana": "{B}{B}", "sacrifice": {"types": ["Creature"], "controller": "you", "zone": "battlefield", "count": 2}} with graveyard_cast "graveyard" validates against CardModel, and Game._cast pays the non-mana half of a graveyard cost through the general payer -- but no gate claims the printed line, so --collect rejects it at the residual gate. _GRAVEYARD_ALTERNATIVE_LINE / _declares_printed_graveyard_alternative in cards/authoring/verify.py accept a mana-only payment and fail closed on anything else (their comment names exactly this card's "{B}{B} and sacrificing two creatures"); _declares_printed_alternative_cost reads sacrifice payments but only for the hand alternative_cost and the "rather than pay this spell's mana cost" wording; _ESCAPE_LINE reads only exile-from-graveyard. Fix: extend the graveyard-alternative claimant to read the sacrifice clause (count word and creature noun) against cost.sacrifice, in the style of _declares_printed_tap, and pin it with a Scourge of Nel Toth test. No engine op is missing
